title: At 1–1, Liverpool are getting through Manchester City's press
body: Liverpool have beaten the first pressing line on 86% of recent attempts, up from 36%.

title: Liverpool toma la iniciativa
body: Con el 1-1 y once contra once, Liverpool ha pasado de 5 a 17 entradas en el último tercio. Además, tuvo un 64% de posesión en los últimos cinco minutos.

title: Press effectiveness down
body: At 1-1 with 11 players each, Liverpool’s bypass rate against Manchester City’s first press line rose from 36% to 86%. City’s defensive line dropped from 30.46m to 27.83m.
